info.title: ProjectBrief Workspace Integrations API
info.description: Stateless workspace bearer API. 120 requests/minute/IP and 60/minute/workspace. Outgoing webhooks use immutable JSON and HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + "." + raw_body). See README for complete management and event delivery semantics. Milestone 5.0.1 adds owner-managed all/selected project webhook filters and opt-in metadata-only client comment events. API tokens remain workspace-scoped. Milestone 5.0.3 adds comments:read, attachments:read, scoped read-only comment/attachment endpoints and authenticated streaming downloads; webhook payloads are unchanged. Text and files may contain personal information; grant only to trusted CRM systems.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Token/workspace/path-scoped replay key, retained without expiry. Same canonical body replays; different body conflicts.

200.description: Existing external identity returned; no mutation.

201.description: Created; original status preserved on replay.

get.description: Requires comments:read, independently of projects:read/tasks:read. Validates project in token workspace before comment lookup. Shared client-visible discussions only, including client/admin authors. Strict filters: taskId requires kind=tasks; unknown query keys are 422. Opaque cursor uses deterministic ascending creation order and an initial high-water mark; do not change token/project/filters/perPage between pages. Hidden/deleted tasks and inconsistent parent links are excluded; removals do not duplicate results. No write API, public URLs, read counts or internal notes.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Requires kind=tasks. UUID must belong to this visible project.

404.description: not_found; absent, hidden, soft-deleted or foreign parent/resource

get.description: Get directly using projectId/commentId from an existing client-comment webhook. Requires comments:read. Missing, foreign, hidden/deleted parent or comment returns 404. Safe attachment metadata only. Webhooks never contain comment text or file bytes.

404.description: not_found; absent, hidden, soft-deleted or foreign parent/resource

get.description: Direct task attachments only; comment attachments use the comment endpoint. Both scopes required. Returns safe metadata without URLs, paths or bytes. Hidden/deleted/foreign project/task is 404.

404.description: not_found; absent, hidden, soft-deleted or foreign parent/resource

get.description: General or task-comment files; both scopes required. Parent comment must remain visible. Returns safe metadata without URLs, paths or bytes.

404.description: not_found; absent, hidden, soft-deleted or foreign parent/resource

get.description: Authenticated streamed original bytes, with Content-Disposition: attachment, nosniff, sandbox CSP and no-store; never redirects to a public/signed URL. Also requires tasks:read for direct task files, or comments:read for comment files (including task-comment files). Checks token workspace, visible parent and consistent task/comment links. Missing file or hidden/deleted/foreign resource returns 404.

200.description: Streamed file bytes, Content-Type equals the stored MIME, Content-Disposition: attachment, Cache-Control: no-store. No public link or file content in JSON.

404.description: not_found; absent, hidden, soft-deleted or foreign parent/resource

managerUrl.description: Relative manager path requiring normal admin login.

estimateHours.description: Only on GET with estimates:read scope.

price.description: Only on GET with estimates:read scope.

sourceSystem.description: Required together with externalId; exact case-sensitive workspace identity.

changes.description: Per-event allowlists in README. Never prices, hours, private notes, clients or file/link secrets.

commentId.description: Present and required only for the two opt-in client comment events. No text, filenames, URLs or personal fields are included.

projectFilter.description: all includes future projects. selected requires a nonempty explicit workspace-owned UUID list.

projectIds.description: Foreign/unavailable UUIDs rejected. Empty for all. Removed projects cascade out; selected then fails closed.

id.description: Client UUID if available; admin has no public UUID and is null.

text.description: Untrusted plain text, possibly personal information; never render as HTML. Only available with comments:read.

attachments.description: Metadata only, also present with comments:read alone; file bytes require attachments:read and the parent read scope.

nextCursor.description: Opaque encrypted continuation; bound to token/project/filters/perPage. Ascending creation order with initial high-water mark. New inserts require restarting. Invalidated by APP_KEY rotation.

post.description: Signed outgoing event. Verify raw bytes, timestamp, deduplicate event id, and return 2xx quickly. Header Event contains event type; Delivery is a stable UUID; Timestamp is Unix seconds; Signature is sha256=<hex HMAC>. Delivery is additionally filtered by endpoint project selection before outbox delivery creation and again before sending/retry. webhook.test bypasses selection. Filter changes version/cancel all pending deliveries; old failed deliveries cannot be retried under a new version.
